Commentary.Commentary: Alrighty then. Things will get much spicier from here on. South Africa level the series 1-1. There are still 3 matches to go. Do join us on 29th June at 2000 Local (6000 GMT) for the third T20I. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Tabraiz Shamsi is up for a chat - He says that the pitch was more like the Caribbean pitches he is used to. Adds that yesterday the conditions came off well for them but today was their day.Says that Pollard is very very smart and he wouldn't have got the wicket if it wasn't for Hendricks who took an excellent catch. Jokes that he is a bit older to do the celebration nowadays. Goes onto say that it would be nice to play with the crowd and the celebrations will come soon. Finally says that they know what West Indies are capable of and it was just their day.

Temba Bavuma is up for a chat- He says that yesterday they had to have the conversation to prove their discipline. Adds that the guys came in having an open mind and the result shows that. Adds that they were able to carry the intensity but didn't capitalize towards the end. Mentions that the spin duo was amazing and as a captain, it makes a lot of things easier. States that he expects the same from them. Adds that they want to keep things simple and enjoy out there. Goes on to say that the conditions here kind of expect bowlers to mix it up and bowl well.

Kieron Pollard is up for a chat- He says that the bowlers did well to restrict South Africa to a decent total. Adds that he knew they will come hard against us. Mentions that they lost the game in between the 7th to 11th overs. Goes onto say that Pooran and Russell were not able to stick there. Further says that they will not hide away from the loss and will come back stronger. States that they need to rotate the strike more. Ends with saying that McCoy is taking the responsibility to bowl in death overs and he is executing his plans well. Finally says that they have one day to rest and will come back stronger.

George Linde, PLAYER OF THE MATCH, is up for a chat - He says that he went back to the basics again and bowled accordingly. He adds that he was happy that the ball came on nicely and mentions that Shamsi is more deserving to get this award. Further states that they got up, looked in the mirror, and said that they could perform better after yesterday's game and says that luckily it worked out well for them.

South Africa did what they just needed as the red-hot duo of Nortje and Rabada removed the in-form Ewin Lewis and the Universe Boss early into the innings. The Spinners then joined the party and ran through their middle order with George Linde and Tabraiz Shamsi sharing 3 wickets between them conceding only 35 runs in 8 overs. The bowlers did exceedingly well to keep West Indies quiet and never gave them a chance to settle. The Proteas pacers did lose momentum towards the end but they still managed to put on a show and level the series.

West Indies never looked into the game. None of the batters managed to settle in and get on a big score. Ewin Lewis started well for West Indies but couldn't repeat his heroics. The wickets kept tumbling for them as Chris Gayle got departed early followed by Pooran and the skipper Pollard. Fletcher stayed long at the crease but never looked settle and ultimately got out forcing himself to go big seeing the run-rate creeping up. Bravo and Allen did play cameos towards the end and tried to build a partnership but it was just not enough. A tough day at the office for the Windies.
SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 16 RUNS. They level the 5-match series 1-1. Fuller, on middle. Sinclair misses his reverse sweeps, back to the keeper.
Kevin Sinclair is the last batsman in.

OUT! LBW! A fantastic knock comes to end! Nor did it matter but was worth watching! Angles this one on a fuller length, on middle. Allen looks to squeeze it out but was too late on his stroke. Gets hit on front pads, Appeal raised and the umpire signals out. Fabian Allen departs for 34 runs.
SIX! The match is done and dusted but Fabian Allen is playing a fine knock here. Moves to 34. Length ball, on off. Allen hits a flattish six over long on.
WIDE! Length ball, way outside off. Allen lets it through and collects a wide.
Length ball, outside off. Allen gets the inside edge to short fine leg as he looks to paddle it.
SIX! 24 needed of 4 deliveries! Another fuller delivery, on middle. Allen heaves it over mid-wicket for a biggie. Is there a twist in the tale?
SIX! 30 runs needed off 5 deliveries! Full ball, on off. Allen smokes it over long off for a biggie.
Another length ball, outside off. Obed McCoy swings and misses.
Fuller ball, outside off. Obed McCoy manages an inside edge towards keeper.
Another length ball, outside off. Obed McCoy slashes but misses.
Length ball, outside off. Obed McCoy swings and misses. The ball rolls to the keeper who has a shy at the strikers end, he scores but the batsmen was well in.
A short ball, outside off. Allen pulls it to mid-wicket for one.
Full toss, outside off. Drilled away to deep point for one.

OUT! CAUGHT! Dwayne Bravo departs and West Indies are 8 down! A low full toss, outside off. Bravo heaves it to mid-wicket where Reeza Hendricks stands on the ropes and takes a brilliant catch. 38 more needed from 12 deliveries. Can things go spicier from here on?
Commentary.Howout: c Reeza Hendricks b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! 18 off the over! Is this the turning point for the windies! Length ball, outside off. Bravo slashes at it but gets a thick outside edge towards third man fence for a boundary.
Full toss, on off. Eased down to long on for one.
SIX! Back to Back! Much needed for the windies! A fuller delivery, on off. Allen gets low and lofts it over the bowlers head for a six.
SIX! Much needed boundary for the windies! Length ball, outside off. Allen hammers it over long on for a biggie.
On the pads. This is flicked to square leg for a single.
Fuller length on off, Bravo works it down to long on for a run.
Fires a yorker on leg, clipped to short fine leg.
FOUR! Lucky Boundary! Bowls a low full toss outside off, Dwayne Bravo went for the drive. However, the ball goes off the inside edge to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Low full toss outside off, pushed towards covers for one.

OUT! RUNOUT! Holder departs! Fuller ball, on off. Allen pushes it to mid off. They run for the second one but Temba Bavuma fires one a quick throw towards bowlers end, where nortje clips the bails off. Single taken.
A length ball, spills it down the leg side. Allen misses his pull.
Review for Caught Behind. UltraEdge shows spike when the ball passes the thigh pad.
Fabian Allen is the new men in.
OUT! CAUGHT! Andre Fletcher goes back in the hut! A fuller ball, outside off. Fletcher gets low and looks to drive uppishly, but hits it straight in the hands of Heinrich Klaasen at extra cover.
Commentary.Howout: c Heinrich Klaasen b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: Low full toss, outside off. Drills it to long on for one.
Innovative! Length ball, outside off. Holder paddle scoops it over short fine leg for  a couple of runs.
Again same line, same length, Holder misses his drive.
Good comeback by Rabada! Fuller ball, outside off. Holder looks to drive but misses.
SIX! Can this change the momentum for West Indies! A short ball, outside off. Jason Holder pulls it high in the air and into the stands at long on for a six.
Kagiso Rabada is back into action.
A back of a length ball, on off. Holder pulls it to long on for a single. 72 runs needed more of 30 balls.
Another slower length ball, outside off. Chops it out to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Welcome Boundary! Yorker length and on middle. Fletcher squeezes it out to fine leg fence for four.
Fuller ball, on middle. Blocked out.
Clever Bowling! A short ball, slower and outside off. Fletcher misses his slash.
Fuller delivery, on middle. Holder tucks it to square leg for a single.
Change. Lungi Ngidi is back into attack.
Full and way outside off, Holder drives it to long off for a single. An excellent spell from Tabraiz Shamsi. He ends with 4-0-16-1.
Fuller on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Review taken for LBW. UltraEdge confirms No Bat. Ball Tracker shows impact outside off stump and the review is lose.

NOT OUT! Floated delivery on off, turning in, Holder is early into his shot as he looks to work it on the leg side. He gets beaten and is struck on the back pad. An inquiry is made for an LBW but the umpire seems not interested. South Africa challenges the umpire. They review it. Ultra Edge confirms no bat involved. The Ball Tracker shows that the ball is pitching outside off and the impact too is outside off.
PLAY AND A MISS! Sharp turn there! Tossed up outside off, Holder went for the shot but misses.
Loopy delivery on leg, tucked away through mid-wicket for another two.
Tossed up on off, cut past point for a brace.
Shorter and down the leg side, Fletcher misses his pull. Wided.
Fuller length on middle, Jason Holder hits it nice and straight towards the long on region. He bags another brace. 84 needed in 42 deliveries.
Short of a length on off, Jason Holder moves across and scoops it over the keeper's head. He picks up a couple of runs.
Full toss again on middle, worked towards long on for a run.
Back of a length delivery on middle, pulled towards square leg for a single.
Full toss on off, worked towards long on for a single.
Fuller length on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Anrich Nortje is back into the attack.
BEATEN! Beautiful delivery! Flatter and quicker outside off. Holder goes for the expansive drive but the ball spins back under his blade and gets beaten.
Loopy ball, outside off. Fletcher prods forward and pushes it to covers for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Flicked to mid-wicket who fumbles to grab it and allows  a single.
Fractionally short, on middle. Holder rocks back and looks to pull but gets beaten. The ball gets hit on his thigh pad and goes to leg slip.
Flatter delivery, outside off. Fletcher lunges forward and pushes it to covers for a single.
Darted on the pads. Holder blocks it on the leg side and sneaks a single.
Floated on off. Holder defends it to covers for a single. George Linde finishes off his excellent spell.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out watchfully.
On middle. Fletcher on drives it to long on for a single.
Jason Holder is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Spinners are doing the job for the Proteas and West Indies are falling like a pack of cards. Loopy ball, on middle. Tempts Russell to go for the heave, but doesn't middle it, Gets a leading-edge, high in the air and towards mid-wicket, where Heinrich Klaasen takes a comfortable catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Heinrich Klaasen b George Linde

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Russell is underway! Pitches it up, on middle. Andre Russell lofts it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Tossed up, on middle. Blocked out.
Loopy ball on off, played to long on for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Tabraiz Shamsi is off on his celebration! What a moment in the match! Tossed up delivery on off, Kieron Pollard goes for the big shot but pays the price. He finds Reeza Hendricks at deep mid-wicket who runs forward and dives to grab the catch. The skipper has to walk back to the hut for a timid score. Vulnerable Pollard tries to slog it, aiming for a maximum but didn't connect it that well. South Africa bossing this game. West Indies in deep trouble.
Commentary.Howout: c Reeza Hendricks b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: Floated it up on off, Pollard works it towards mid off.
Loopy ball on the pads, Pollard misses his flick. The ball goes off the pads on the leg side.
Short on leg, chopped to covers for a single.
BEATEN! How did it miss hitting the stumps! Bowls a tossed up delivery on off, spinning away, Fletcher is completely beaten on his attempted defense.
Fuller again on leg, whipped towards long on for a single. What an over for South Africa. Excellent bowling from George Linde. They have certainly pulled things back into their side.
Fuller on leg, flicked towards square leg for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! West Indies in a spot of bother now! Clever from Linde as he bowls flatter and quicker one on off, Nicholas Pooran went for the big shot. He was anticipating some turn but didn't find that. He gets a top-edge and the ball lands up into the hands of David Miller at long on.
Commentary.Howout: c David Miller b George Linde

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up on off, blocked out on the off side. The batters sneak a quick single.
BEATEN! Loopy ball on off, Fletcher looks to cut but misses.
Loopy ball on off, cut straight to point.
Fuller delivery, on off. Fletcher tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off. Pooran punches it off the back foot towards long of for a single.
BEATEN! Lands it on middle and spins away, beating the defensive stroke of Pooran.
Again tossed up, on middle. Solidly blocked out.
Tossed up, on middle. Pooran paddles it to vacant short fine leg for a couple of runs.
Pitches it up, around off. Fletcher makes room and sweeps it to long on for a single.
Outside off. Left alone to the keeper. Just 3 runs coming off this over.
Spin from the other end as well. Tabraiz Shamsi is introduced into the attack now.
On middle. Fletcher steps down and flicks it to mid-wicket for  asingle.
Loopy ball, on middle. Dabbed towards point. Fletcher wants the single but Pooran sends him back
Another tossed up delivery, on middle. Fletcher checks his shot and blocks it out.
Tossed up, on middle. Fletcher looks to defend against the turn but gets hit on the pads.
Fractionally short, outside off. Fletcher cuts it past point fielder and towards sweeper cover for two.
George Linde is back into the attack.

Slower length outside off, Andre Fletcher cuts it past point. Anrich Nortje gives it a chase and does well to pull the ball back in time. Three runs taken. End of the powerplay. South Africa 53 for 2.
FOUR! Nicely played! Fuller length on middle, Andre Fletcher hits it straight over the bowler's head for a boundary. The safest place to hit and he finds it to perfection.
Good length delivery on leg, Andre Fletcher went for the slog but misses. He gets hit on the pads. An appeal made for LBW but turned down.
Back of a length on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Quality shot! Length delivery on leg, Nicholas Pooran ticks it away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Fuller and on off, Pooran defends it watchfully.
Change. Lungi Ngidi is back into action. His figures 1-0-11-0.
Short and on middle, Fletcher takes his eyes off the ball. He gets a blow on the gloves. Top over from Kagiso Rabada.
Length delivery on off, punched towards point for a single.
On middle, Pooran pushes it to mid on.
Nicholas Pooran is the new men in.

OUT! CAUGHT! BIG WICKET! Kagiso Rabada gets the big fish. Full length delivery on leg, Chris Gayle went for the flick but timed it a little too early. The ball goes off the outside edge and went up straight in the air. George Linde at covers takes the simplest of catches. He won't drop those. South Africa gets two early wickets. Just the start they were looking for.
Commentary.Howout: c George Linde b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: Slower ball on off, pushed towards point for a run.
Slower ball on middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
On middle. This is punched to mid of for a single.  Excellent over from Anrich Nortje, 11 runs conceded but a big wicket of Evin Lewis.
FOUR! The Universe Boss is into the business! A short ball, on middle. Chris Gayle rocks back and pulls it to mid-wicket for a one bounce four.
Short ball, on middle. Gayle misses his pull shot.
Off the mark straightaway! On a length, outside off. Gayle pushes it through covers for a couple of runs.
Chris Gayle walks out to bat at No.3.

OUT! TIMBER! Nortje takes the revenge back! A fuller ball, around middle and leg. Lewis looks to heave it from his crease. His feet move nowhere and the ball goes under his blade, shattering the middle stump. No Evin Lewis show this time, as he departs for 21 runs.
FOUR! Well Played! Welcomes Anrich Nortje to bowling! A length ball, outside off. Lewis dabs it in between third man and backward point for a boundary.

DROPPED! Hard chance but, the Proteas have to be on top of their game! Fuller ball, outside off. Fletcher dances down and cuts it towards the point fielder, who dives to his left and fumbles to grab the ball.
Anrich Nortje is brought into the attack.
Short ball, on middle. Ducked under it.
SIX! What a way to get off the mark! Pitched up, around off. Andre Fletcher lofts it straight down the ground over the bowlers head for a biggie.
Excellent delivery! Yorker on middle. Andre Fletcher digs it out in time.
On a length ball, on middle. Lewis nudges it to mid on and sneaks a single.
Fuller ball, on middle and off. Pushed to covers for nothing.
Kagiso Rabada replaces George Linde.
Evin Lewis is really taking Lungi Ngidi to the cleaners. Got better of him in the last game and showing his intent straightaway in this match as well.
Low full toss on off, Lewis hits it towards mid off. Miller puts in a dive but the ball sneaks past him. Lewis wanted the second run but Fletcher sends him back.
Full and outside off, worked towards mid off.
FOUR! Excellent! Fuller ball on middle, Evin Lewis rockets it down the ground towards long off for a boundary.

Length delivery on the pads, Lewis misses his flick. The ball hits his pads and rolls on the leg side. There is no fielder over on the square leg region. The batters sneak two off the leg bye. Poor fielding by South Africa.
FOUR! He is continuing from where he left off! Length delivery on off, Evin Lewis lofts it towards long off for a boundary.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Lewis misses his flick. Wided.
Another full toss on off, pushed to mid off.
Starts with a high full toss on off, Lewis sways away from it. Umpire signals it as no-ball. Free-hit coming up.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Lungi Ngidi.
Outside off, Fletcher blocks it out.
Fortune favors the brave! Flighted delivery on off, Evin Lewis skips down the pitch and looks to heave. The ball goes off the outside edge over point. A single taken.
Floated it up on off, Lewis punches it off the back foot towards cover-point.
Tossed up on off, punched towards point.
SIX! UP AND OVER! Loopy delivery on middle, Evin Lewis gets on his knees and sweeps it over deep square leg for a maximum. Just the start he was looking for.
Tossed up on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
